question.text:
System1 Group's Test Your Ad shows each new UK TV ad to a nationally representative sample of UK adults, measures their second-by-second emotional response and publishes a Star Rating from 1.0 to 5.9 stars (one decimal) that predicts the ad's long-term brand-building potential. What Star Rating will System1 publish for the following UK Christmas 2026 ad? Ad description:
Brand: John Lewis (UK)
Ad title: Gloria and Pickles
Released: 3 November 2026 (brand online release; first TV slots that evening on ITV and Channel 4)
Length of the main edit: 180 seconds
Format: not stated
Setting: Gloria's home at Christmas, with a trip across London.
Characters: Gloria (Dame Kristin Scott Thomas, named actress); Pickles, a vintage toy dog (voice of Paul Whitehouse, named actor); Gloria's family, grandchildren Freddie and Maggie.
Story:
1. On Christmas Eve, Gloria's restless grandchildren ignore her old toy dog, Pickles.
2. Alone, Gloria puts cash into cards.
3. Pickles comes to life and says: "You can do better than cash."
4. A TukTuk carries them across London to John Lewis to hunt for gifts.
5. On Christmas morning the children open empty envelopes; Gloria gives them a key to her home office, now the "Gran Cave" with lights, disco balls and music.
Music: "You Can't Always Get What You Want", Sam Fender cover of The Rolling Stones song, with choir and brass band.
Dialogue and voiceover: Pickles' line above; others not stated.
Tone: heartfelt, magical
Brand and product presence: A John Lewis shop front appears during the trip; products shown include a Fisher Price Little Snoopy pull-along toy, decorations, lighting, turntable and cushions. Logo timing not stated. End line: "Don't Give Up on Giving."
